text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success, and using the SMART framework is a great way to start. This means your goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once you have your main goals, break them down into smaller milestones. These are checkpoints that help you track progress and keep the team motivated. Each milestone should lead to a clear deliverable, like a report, a prototype, or a finished feature. Finally, stakeholder alignment is crucial. Make sure everyone involved—from team members to managers—understands and agrees on the goals. Regular communication keeps everyone on the same page and prevents confusion later on.
